name: Assurant
description: Assurant insures and services consumer purchases rather than people: extended-warranty and protection contracts on mobile phones, consumer electronics and appliances (sold through mobile carriers, device makers and retailers), vehicle service contracts, and lender-placed homeowners insurance. Global Lifestyle is 78 percent of revenue and Global Housing 23 percent. It earns premiums and fees, and also provides the administrative support and related services; it earns more per dollar of revenue in Housing (adjusted EBITDA $859M on $2.9B) than in Lifestyle ($801M on $9.9B). Housing earnings swing with hurricanes and other catastrophes ($199M of reportable catastrophe losses in 2025).

gics.note: Conventional label per Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01), which gives only the sector and the sub-industry; GICS industry group and industry are not shown there so are left null. Mowgli classification is not set here.

employees.note: Approximately 14,800 employees in 21 markets; 72% in North America; about 61% frontline roles (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Global Lifestyle
businessLines.how: Clients (carriers, retailers, dealers, lenders) distribute the products, consumers pay premiums or fees for coverage after the manufacturer warranty, and Assurant earns premiums plus fees for administration, repair, logistics and claims services; about 81 percent of revenue is from North America.
businessLines.description: Connected Living (extended service contracts and device protection on mobile devices, consumer electronics and appliances through mobile carriers, OEMs, cable operators and retailers) and Global Automotive (vehicle service contracts, GAP and other ancillary products).

revenue.note: FY2024 $9,323.9M (+7%). Net earned premiums, fees and other income: Connected Living $5,378.7M (FY2024 $4,807.9M), Global Automotive $4,203.8M (FY2024 $4,159.4M). Regional: North America 80.7%, Latin America 7.7%, Europe 5.9%, Asia Pacific 5.7%

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $9,323.9M (+7%). Net earned premiums, fees and other income: Connected Living $5,378.7M (FY2024 $4,807.9M), Global Automotive $4,203.8M (FY2024 $4,159.4M). Regional: North America 80.7%, Latin America 7.7%, Europe 5.9%, Asia Pacific 5.7%

businessLines.name: Global Housing
businessLines.how: Lender-placed coverage: premiums are paid on policies placed when a borrower has no coverage of their own, so revenue grows with policies in force and average premium; underwriting results swing with catastrophe losses.
businessLines.description: Homeowners (including lender-placed policies) and Renters and Other insurance.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $671.2M (+28%); catastrophe losses reported separately $198.8M (FY2024 $245.2M); Q2 2026 $274.8M vs $214.4M (+28%)
